# Upstream and dependency notices

Lumine derives from [zgui](https://github.com/senxd/zgui). The imported source revision is `e9e03ce5aebb1215d04fb60357af00332c36e347`. Its original copyright and MIT permission notice is preserved verbatim in [zgui-LICENSE.txt](zgui-LICENSE.txt).

That notice applies to the inherited upstream software. Lumine does not grant a repository-wide license for its fork-specific additions or modifications. No root LICENSE file is provided.

Dependency and asset notices remain with their sources, including `assets/FONT-LICENSE`, the portal parent implementation notices, and the MIT/Apache notices in `vendor/cosmic-text` and `vendor/wgpu-hal`. Their original copyright and permission text is unchanged.
